item3.fundsSource:
On September 8, 2026, the Issuer, GameSquare IP Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation and subsidiary of the Issuer ("Buyer"), FanEngine Holdings Ltd., a private company established under the laws of England and Wales ("FanEngine"), the beneficial owners of FanEngine (the "Seller Securityholders"), including the Reporting Person, and Jesper Schertiger, solely in his capacity as Seller Securityholder Representative, entered into a Contribution Agreement (the "Contribution Agreement"). Prior to the Closing, all or substantially all of the assets of the Reporting Person were transferred to FanEngine. Pursuant to the Contribution Agreement, FanEngine contributed substantially all of its assets to Buyer in exchange for the issuance by the Issuer to the Seller Securityholders of shares of Common Stock equal in aggregate to thirty percent (30%) of the total issued and outstanding shares of Common Stock as of the closing date, after giving effect to such issuance (the "Issued Shares"), allocated among the Seller Securityholders in accordance with Schedule A to the Contribution Agreement, plus a contingent Earnout Amount.
The transactions closed on October 26, 2026 (the "Closing"), following receipt of the approval of the Issuer's stockholders required by Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(a). At the Closing, the Reporting Person received 979,095 Issued Shares, representing its pro rata percentage of 18.00% set forth on Schedule A to the Contribution Agreement. Share amounts in this Statement reflect the Issuer's 1-for-8 reverse stock split effective August 24, 2026. No cash consideration was paid by the Reporting Person; the shares were issued in exchange for the contribution of assets by FanEngine.

item4.transactionPurpose:
The Reporting Person acquired the securities reported herein as consideration for the contribution of assets under the Contribution Agreement and holds such securities for investment purposes. Sanzib Khaund, the Chief Executive Officer of the Reporting Person, is the Chief Technology Officer of the Issuer and, in such capacity, may from time to time participate in discussions and decisions of the Issuer's management regarding the matters described in this Item 4.
Pursuant to the Contribution Agreement, effective as of the Closing the Issuer agreed to appoint to its board of directors two individuals, each separately nominated by one of two Seller Securityholders designated as a "Designating Holder." The Issuer must include each Seller Designee in its slate of nominees at each annual meeting for so long as the applicable Designating Holder holds at least 5% of the outstanding Common Stock, subject to applicable law, Nasdaq rules and the directors' fiduciary duties. The Reporting Person is not a Designating Holder and has no right to nominate a Seller Designee.
Under the Contribution Agreement, the Seller Securityholders are eligible to receive (i) additional shares of Common Stock equal to up to ten percent (10%) of the issued and outstanding Common Stock as of the closing date (the "Share Earnout Amount"), in two 5% tranches contingent upon revenue milestones measured during the six-month period following Closing and the period from six to eighteen months following Closing, and (ii) a cash earnout of up to $50 million based on Earnout Net Income for the periods ending December 31, 2027 and December 31, 2028. Any Share Earnout Amount would be allocated in accordance with the Reporting Person's pro rata percentage of 18.00% on Schedule A. Because the issuance of such shares depends on future performance, the Reporting Person does not currently beneficially own any shares comprising the Share Earnout Amount.
Except as set forth in this Statement, the Reporting Person does not have any present plans or proposals that relate to or would result in any of the actions specified in clauses (a) through (j) of Item 4 of Schedule 13D. The Reporting Person may, subject to applicable law, the Issuer's insider trading policy and the terms of the Contribution Agreement, acquire additional securities of the Issuer or dispose of securities of the Issuer, and reserves the right to change its intentions with respect to any of the foregoing.

item6.contractDescription:
The information set forth in Items 3 and 4 is incorporated herein by reference. The Reporting Person is a party to the Contribution Agreement, which includes, among other things, the following provisions relating to the securities of the Issuer:
Seller Securityholder Representative: each Seller Securityholder irrevocably appointed Jesper Schertiger as its exclusive agent and attorney-in-fact for notices, elections and other actions relating to the Issued Shares and any Earnout Amount, including share forfeiture elections and legend removal requests.
Earnout: the contingent right to the Share Earnout Amount and Cash Earnout Amount described in Item 4. Any Share Earnout Amount will be subject to the same terms, conditions and restrictions as the Issued Shares.
Indemnification; share forfeiture and set-off: indemnification obligations of the Seller Securityholders may be satisfied by forfeiting Issued Shares or Share Earnout shares to the Issuer for cancellation, valued at their original issuance value, and the Issuer and Buyer may set off amounts owed against unissued shares or earnout amounts.
Board designation: the right of two Designating Holders each to nominate one Seller Designee to the Issuer's board of directors, as described in Item 4.
Legend removal and piggyback registration rights: the Issuer must remove restrictive legends in connection with Rule 144 sales, and, on or after six months following Closing, must offer the Seller Securityholders the opportunity to include their Registrable Securities in certain registration statements, subject to underwriter cutbacks.
No trading while in possession of MNPI: each Seller Securityholder agreed not to trade Issuer securities while in possession of material nonpublic information.
Lock-up: Section 2.06(e)(i) refers to "any applicable lock-up" on the Issued Shares. Mr. Khaund is party to an offer letter with the Issuer dated August 31, 2026 and holds the equity awards described in Item 5.
The Reporting Person has no contract, arrangement, understanding or relationship with any other Seller Securityholder with respect to the voting or disposition of shares of Common Stock, and disclaims membership in any group, within the meaning of Section 13(d)(3) of the Act, with any other Seller Securityholder. Except as described herein, the Reporting Person is not a party to any contracts, arrangements, understandings or relationships (legal or otherwise) with respect to any securities of the Issuer.
